# cloudxino_firewall (Resource)

A Cloud Firewall. It applies to the servers in `server_ids` and to every server with one of its `tags`. Traffic a rule does not allow is dropped.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudxino_firewall" "web" {
  name = "web"

  inbound_rule = [
    { protocol = "tcp", ports = "80,443", sources = ["0.0.0.0/0"] },
    { protocol = "tcp", ports = "22", sources = ["203.0.113.7/32"] },
    { protocol = "icmp", sources = ["0.0.0.0/0"] },
  ]

  # Left out: all outbound traffic is allowed.
  # outbound_rule = [{ protocol = "tcp", ports = "all", destinations = ["0.0.0.0/0"] }]

  # Every server with one of these tags gets the firewall.
  tags = ["web"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `inbound_rule` (Attributes List) Traffic allowed in. None = nothing in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inbound_rule))
- `outbound_rule` (Attributes List) Traffic allowed out. Left out: everything out is allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--outbound_rule))
- `server_ids` (Set of String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Servers with any of these tags get this firewall.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `server_count` (Number)
- `status` (String) `pending`, `active` or `error`.

<a id="nestedatt--inbound_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inbound_rule`

Required:

- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`.
- `sources` (List of String) IPv4 addresses or networks; `0.0.0.0/0` = anywhere.

Optional:

- `ports` (String) `22`, `80,443`, `8000-8100` or `all`. Left out (or empty) means all ports; ICMP has no ports.


<a id="nestedatt--outbound_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `outbound_rule`

Required:

- `destinations` (List of String) IPv4 addresses or networks; `0.0.0.0/0` = anywhere.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`.

Optional:

- `ports` (String) `22`, `80,443`, `8000-8100` or `all`. Left out (or empty) means all ports; ICMP has no ports.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import cloudxino_firewall.web <firewall_id>
```
